locations.title: Places
locations.description: Coordinates as latitude,longitude, one pair per row, for example 50.45,30.52. Every pair that is not a real point comes back free with the reason.

units.title: Units
units.description: metric: celsius, km/h, mm. imperial: fahrenheit, mph, inch (precipitation is converted too, not just relabelled).

maxLocations.title: Max places per run
maxLocations.description: Every place past this number still gets a free row that says it was not attempted.

hours.title: Hours of the series
hours.description: How many points of the series to return per place, 1 to 72. Near the point the source is hourly; past that it gives a 6 or 12 hour step, and each entry says which step it came from in precipitationStepHours.

includeDaily.title: Include the daily high and low
includeDaily.description: Add one entry per day with the minimum and maximum temperature and the precipitation sum, computed from the same series.
